value.rationale: Heawood is the canonical finite-projective-plane incidence graph and the unique smallest cubic girth-six graph; its complete inhibitory attractor basins are a natural exact dynamical invariant. The theorem explains from Fano geometry the 21 isolated fixed points, eight distinct two-cycle basin sizes, and uniquely dominant basin of 4097 states, providing useful benchmark beyond a generic fixed-point enumeration.
